gizmo.title: Nā kikoʻī

configure.title: Pihi
configure.description: Hōʻuluʻulu o ka ʻike inā hūnā ʻia, e laʻa me "ʻike", "metadata", a pēlā aku.

configure.title: Wehewehe

advanced.title: Kikokikona hōʻuluʻulu koho ke wehe ʻia nā kikoʻī
